text:
Ana M.: Quick check — spotted an external link in the 'Embedding samples' snippet in runtime guide that points to a third-party dataset. Legal flagged it in the scan. Anyone owns runtime guide? We should confirm license or rehost a tiny sample. 
docs-bot: automated-link-scan: flagged https://datasets.example.org/sample.tar.gz (reason: external third-party hosting) :warning:
Mike R.: I usually own the runtime guide section. Which page/line? 
Ana M.: It's under /docs/runtime/embeddings.md, code block that shows curl to download sample.
Ana M.: snippet:
```
curl -O https://datasets.example.org/sample.tar.gz
tar -xzf sample.tar.gz
python embed.py --data sample/
```
Sara D.: cc @jules — legal will probably want either a permissive license or for us to host a trimmed sample. :eyes:
Jules L.: Jules L. (Legal): quick read — the dataset is CC-BY-NC-SA, which is non-commercial-sharealike. That could be incompatible with redistribution in some contexts. If the sample includes model inputs/outputs we might need to rehost a tiny synthetic sample and add attribution. 
Mike R.: Ok. Plan: (1) replace curl with rehosted synthetic sample on our CDN, (2) add attribution + license note in the snippet, (3) open a tiny PR and ping docs reviewers. 
Ana M.: I'll generate a tiny synthetic tarball and open the PR. 
Ana M.: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4987 — contains sample.tar.gz -> hosted at https://assets.redwood.com/docs/samples/embed-sample.tar.gz and updates to snippet + footnote. 
Mike R.: Nice, ping me for CR. I'll do the doc changes review first pass. :thumbsup:
Sara D.: Happy to do a quick editorial pass after Mike. ETA EOD today. 
Jules L.: Legal: once PR is up, I'll confirm the wording. If you host synthetic sample on our CDN we should be fine; include a one-liner license header in the repo.
Ana M.: PR opened, added tests to ensure no outgoing curl in CI for docs. Thanks all. 
Mike R.: Merged the quick fix branch into staging, assigned follow-up to runtime docs backlog for more thorough sample guide. 
Ana M.: Thanks — closing loop. :raised_hands:
